I'm trying to tackle creating a program with grid partitions of 4x4 cells. Each grid has separators at rows 4, 9, 14 and columns 4, 9, 14, resulting in 4x4 panels of 4x4 each. The colors need to be set as bg5 and separators at 9. I also want to infer transformations for the patterns in each panel.

def transform(grid):
    # Solid separator lines divide the grid into panels. A panel with exactly
    # two cells unlike the dominant background is marked 1; otherwise it keeps
    # the background color.
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    sep_rows = [r for r in range(h) if len(set(grid[r])) == 1]
    sep_rows = [r for r in sep_rows if all(v != 0 for v in grid[r])]
    sep_cols = [c for c in range(w) if all(grid[r][c] == grid[0][c] for r in range(h)) and len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1]
    # Select the most frequent solid full lines as separators. Grid separators
    # are the uniform rows/columns that differ from the dominant panel color.
    vals = [v for row in grid for v in row if v not in set()]
    counts = {}
    for v in vals:
        counts[v] = counts.get(v, 0) + 1
    # separator color is the most common color among fully uniform rows/cols
    lines = [grid[r][0] for r in range(h) if len(set(grid[r])) == 1]
    line_counts = {v: lines.count(v) for v in set(lines)}
    sep_color = max(line_counts, key=line_counts.get)
    sep_rows = [r for r in range(h) if all(x == sep_color for x in grid[r])]
    sep_cols = [c for c in range(w) if all(grid[r][c] == sep_color for r in range(h))]
    cells = [x for row in grid for x in row if x != sep_color]
    bg = max(set(cells), key=cells.count)
    rb = [-1] + sep_rows + [h]
    cb = [-1] + sep_cols + [w]
    out = []
    for i in range(len(rb)-1):
        row = []
        for j in range(len(cb)-1):
            n = sum(grid[r][c] != bg for r in range(rb[i]+1, rb[i+1]) for c in range(cb[j]+1, cb[j+1]))
            row.append(1 if n == 2 else bg)
        out.append(row)
    return out
